cells.gaps: No source found says a law, decree or regulation on public bodies sharing data is in force; the legal diploma the 2020 resolution orders is not reported as passed.
cells.note: Hand-staged on the rebuild of 2026-11-10: Resolution 54/2020 orders a legal diploma on interoperability to be drafted, so it is an executive instrument that legislation is to replace and stops at stage 2, as Liberia's order does. Its sharing duty lifts only a law in force.
